source.author: verg
source.text: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem, matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.
source.text_original: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem, / matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.
source.text_english: Begin, little boy, to know your mother by her smile; your mother has borne ten long months of weariness for you.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quae autem potest maior esse clementia, quam ut filius dei hominis filius nasceretur, decem mensum fastidia sustineret, partus expectaret aduentum, inuolueretur pannis, subiceretur parentibus, per singulas adoleret aetates et post contumelias uocum, alapas et flagella crucis quoque pro nobis fieret maledictum, ut nos a maledicto legis absolueret patri factus oboediens usque ad mortem, et id opere compleret, quod ante ex persona mediatoris fuerat deprecatus dicens: pater, uolo, ut, quomodo ego et tu unum sumus, et isti in nobis unum sint?
reuse.text_original: quae autem potest maior esse clementia, quam ut filius dei hominis filius nasceretur, decem mensum fastidia sustineret, partus expectaret aduentum, inuolueretur pannis, subiceretur parentibus, per singulas adoleret aetates et post contumelias uocum, alapas et flagella crucis quoque pro nobis fieret maledictum, ut nos a maledicto legis absolueret patri factus oboediens usque ad mortem, et id opere compleret, quod ante ex persona mediatoris fuerat deprecatus dicens: pater, uolo, ut, quomodo ego et tu unum sumus, et isti in nobis unum sint?
reuse.text_english: But what greater mercy can there be than that the Son of God should be born as the son of man, endure the loathsomeness of ten months, await the coming of birth, be wrapped in swaddling clothes, be subject to parents, grow through each stage of life, and after the insults of words, blows, and whips, should even be made a curse for our sake on the cross, so that he might free us from the curse of the Law, becoming obedient to the Father even unto death, and fulfill in deed what he had before implored in the person of the mediator, saying: Father, I wish that, as I and you are one, so these also may be one in us?
